title: Minneapolis Restaurant Health Inspections
description: Every food inspection and violation the City of Minneapolis publishes: business, address, risk level, inspection type, result, score, violation text and inspector comments. Filter by business, date, result or ZIP.
why: A failed or re-inspected kitchen is a business that needs help this week: pest control, equipment repair, food-safety training, consultants. The city publishes each inspection line by line.
useCases: Food-safety consultants and pest-control firms finding restaurants with fresh violations
Restaurant buyers and brokers doing diligence
Diners and reporters checking a kitchen's record

inspectedSince.title: Inspected on or after (YYYY-MM-DD)
inspectedSince.description: Only inspections on or after this date.

limits: Minneapolis-licensed food facilities only. One row per violation line, so one inspection can return several rows.
